tools.name: random
tools.description: DRBG-derived random bytes (base64), anonymous and rate-limited. Capped at 64 bytes/request; powers the public dice player.

tools.name: dice
tools.description: Rejection-sampled dice rolls (no modulo bias), anonymous and rate-limited. Echoes the DRBG bytes drawn for transparency.

tools.name: random_bytes
tools.description: Canonical developer endpoint: DRBG-derived bytes in hex or base64 with a signed provenance receipt. Requires X-API-Key; 32..4096 bytes; per-key rate limit + daily quota.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify the provenance of an issued value from its request_id and/or receipt. Provenance only -- never a value-confirmation oracle. Anonymous, rate-limited.

tools.name: kem_keypair
tools.description: Generate an ML-KEM-768 (Kyber, post-quantum) keypair seeded from the QRNG->DRBG chain. Public key always returned; secret key only for the demo flow (loud demo-only note). Requires X-API-Key.

tools.name: kem_encapsulate
tools.description: Encapsulate against a supplied ML-KEM-768 public key to produce a ciphertext (and, for the demo, the shared secret). Requires X-API-Key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "kem_keypair" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
